nodes.summary: `(∑ δ_{x_i})(s) = #{i | x_i ∈ s}`, as a sum of indicators.
nodes.title: Counting measure of a set as a sum of indicators

nodes.summary: The image of `∑ δ_{x_i}` under `T` is `∑ δ_{T(x_i)}`.
nodes.title: Image of a counting measure under a map

nodes.summary: The counting measure `∑_{i < n} δ_{x_i}` of a finite tuple of points.
nodes.title: Counting measure of a finite tuple of points

nodes.summary: For measurable `f : E → [0, ∞)`, `E exp(-∫ f dη) = exp(-∫ (1 - e^{-f}) dμ)` (Last–Penrose Thm. 3.9). The integral `∫ f dη` is a finite sum `∑ f(x_i)` for every configuration charged by the process.
nodes.title: Laplace functional

nodes.summary: For measurable `h : E × Measure E → [0, ∞]`, `E ∫ h(x, η) η(dx) = ∫ E h(x, η + δ_x) μ(dx)` (Mecke 1967; Last–Penrose Thm. 4.1).
nodes.title: Mecke equation

nodes.summary: `E ∫ f dη = ∫ f dμ` for measurable `f : E → [0, ∞]` (Last–Penrose Prop. 2.7).
nodes.title: Campbell's formula
Integral of a coordinate function under a product measure

nodes.summary: The number of points `η(B)` in a measurable set `B` has the Poisson law of mean `μ(B)`.
nodes.title: Point counts of a Poisson point process are Poisson

nodes.summary: The counts `η(A i)` of pairwise disjoint measurable sets are independent, and `η(A i)` has the Poisson law of mean `μ(A i)`: the mixed binomial process is a Poisson process with intensity `μ` in the sense of Last–Penrose Def. 3.1 (Last–Penrose Prop. 3.5).
nodes.title: Mixed binomial process is a Poisson process

nodes.summary: The image `η ∘ T⁻¹` of a Poisson point process under a measurable map `T : E → F` is the Poisson point process with intensity `μ ∘ T⁻¹` (Last–Penrose Thm. 5.1).
nodes.title: Mapping theorem

nodes.summary: The restrictions `η|_{A i}` of a Poisson point process with finite intensity `μ` to pairwise disjoint measurable sets `A i` are independent Poisson point processes with intensities `μ|_{A i}` (Last–Penrose Thm. 5.2).
nodes.title: Restriction theorem

nodes.summary: The counting measure of a tuple depends measurably on the tuple.
nodes.title: Measurability of the counting measure in the points

nodes.summary: The law of the Poisson point process with finite intensity `μ` on `E`: `∑_n e^{-μ(E)} / n! • (μ^{⊗n}).map countingMeasure`, a probability measure on `Measure E` (Last–Penrose Prop. 3.5, mixed binomial construction).
nodes.title: Poisson point process with finite intensity

nodes.summary: The Poisson weights sum to one: `∑_n e^{-μ(E)} μ(E)^n / n! = 1`.
nodes.title: Poisson weights sum to one

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
